data.one_liner: Flutter Web Plugin to pick Images and Videos as Widget, File or Uint8List.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter Web applications to pick single or multiple images and videos. Files can be loaded as memory bytes, Widgets, or HTML File objects.
use_when: You are building a Flutter Web application that requires selecting images or videos from the device
You need to handle picked media as Uint8List, Widget, or html.File
avoid_when: You need a cross-platform solution (use image_picker instead)
You need to play large local videos directly inside Flutter Web without uploading first
strengths: Supports multiple image and video selection
Provides media as widgets, bytes, or files directly on Flutter Web
weaknesses: Web-only plugin; does not cover mobile or desktop platforms natively
Cannot play local video files directly due to browser security restrictions
data.setup_notes: Add image_picker_web to pubspec.yaml and use methods from ImagePickerWeb class.

alternatives.name: image_picker
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need cross-platform support (mobile, desktop, and web) instead of web-only.

alternatives.name: image_picker_for_web
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this as the official web implementation when using the federated image_picker package.
